name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.extend_defines
typeText:
∀ (γ : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance) {A : Type},
  DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.Valid γ →
    ∀
      (I :
        DisequalityDispersion.Interpretation (Fin (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.m γ))
          (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.arity γ) A)
      (a : Fin (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.k γ) → A) (d : A),
      DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.Defines γ I a d (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.extend γ I a d)

source.code:
theorem extend_defines (hv : γ.Valid) (I : Interpretation (Fin γ.m) γ.arity A)
    (a : Fin γ.k → A) (d : A) : γ.Defines I a d (γ.extend I a d) := by
  intro j
  show (γ.evalNodes I a d).getD j.1 d = _
  unfold evalNodes
  rw [buildList_getD _ _ _ j.2]
  apply γ.evalStep_congr hv I a d j.1 j.2
  intro i hi
  rw [ofFn_extend_getD]
  unfold evalNodes
  rw [buildList_getD _ _ _ (lt_trans hi j.2), buildList_getD _ _ _ hi]
